notes: Home's communication map is now interactive: click any device to jump straight to its tab, with softer status cards and smoother transitions. Live View draws Puretip One as the gantry it really is - the head moves only up and down its column while the deck slides each station underneath - and both panels have a Show animation button that runs a sample cycle with no hardware attached. The Bioyond cell plan is now editable: drag, resize, rename, add and delete your own fixtures and the layout is kept on this PC.
